name: connect
synopsis: int connect(int sockfd, const struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t addrlen);
description: The connect() system call connects the socket referred to by the file descriptor sockfd to the address specified by addr. It establishes a connection for stream sockets or sets the default address for datagram sockets. The addrlen argument specifies the size of the addr structure.

parameters.name: sockfd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the socket to connect.

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Pointer to the sockaddr structure containing the address to connect to.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error
